note: Layer-3 anchors. Each entry is the canonical-state SHA-256 (core.layers.l3_forgetting.state_checksum: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the FULL state body — retained records, handle index, and aggregated forgetting record, BOUNDARY.md §2.4) after replaying a frozen corpus into a fresh forgetting engine at layer_cap=3. These are NEW anchors, not a change to anchors/l1.json or anchors/l2.json: those record replay under make_engine(layer_cap=1) and make_engine(layer_cap=2) through their own engines and stay byte-identical forever; the capped constructor is what makes old anchors eternal. The base corpora entries anchor Layer-3 retention and its cheaper handle index at DEFAULT_BUDGET (no eviction: evicted=0). The l3streamb_under_pressure entry anchors what this layer is actually for — the exact post-eviction state at the gate's own 11000-unit cap, so a drift in the importance law, the eviction order, the tie-break, the forgetting record's coarsening, the cost model, or the serializer moves the hash and turns the suite red. Anchors are frozen: never edited after this session (BOUNDARY.md §9, CLAUDE.md §5).
